description: app::on_terminate hooks can run inside the controller's STATE borrow (the flick module calls app::quit from activate), so a quit hook that touches module state panics with a double borrow.
resolution: Quit hooks use only static data or open a second Store connection (see activity/wire.rs).

content: activity/mod.rs sits at ~496 of its 500-line budget; put new activity features in a sibling file with 'impl Activity' (child modules can reach private fields) instead of growing mod.rs

Avoid calling the real urls::ask or osascript in tests because it sends Apple Events and triggers the Automation prompt; answer Env::ask_url by hand. Background results reach activity via ModuleChanged{activity} plus a per-instance Arc<Mutex> inbox.

description: Feedback 'activity view shows only the browser, no URLs' had two causes: the feedback build predated URL recording, and the launcher Today view (today_items) builds rows from an explicit kind list, so Report fields added for the CLI (top_domains, top_titles) never reach the view.
resolution: Compare the feedback build sha to the feature commit (merge-base --is-ancestor), compare Flick's start time (ps -o lstart) with url-bearing rows via sqlite3 -readonly on flick.db, and when adding a Report field decide whether today_items should list it.
